title: Misere Quotients for Impartial Games: Supplementary Material
notes: Appendix-level algorithms for computing and verifying misere quotients. A reduced quotient has, for every distinct pair, a distinguishing context z with exactly one of xz, yz in P. Solver least-failures refute a candidate outcome recursion; they are not the same object as quotient distinguishing witnesses. Bounded raw-game context lists are approximations; completeness requires all quotient contexts after the quotient is known, explicit separators, or the published verification criterion.
